title: Safety Kernel live decision feed
description: Real-time scrolling list of policy decisions from WebSocket events. Shows: timestamp, job type, decision (allow/deny/approve/throttle), rule matched, eval time. Color-coded by decision. Hero element of the page.
definitionOfDone: Scrolling list of safety decisions from WebSocket events
Each entry: timestamp, job type/topic, decision badge (allow=green, deny=red, approve=yellow, throttle=orange), rule matched, eval time in ms
Hero element — prominent placement on page
Empty state when no events yet

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/home/SafetyDecisionFeed.tsx: Subscribes to useEventStore events buffer (filtered for safety decision events). Renders scrolling list with auto-scroll. Each entry: timestamp (formatted to HH:mm:ss.SSS), job type/topic, decision badge (Badge component: allow=success, deny=danger, require_approval=warning, throttle=info), matched rule name, eval time in ms. Max 100 entries displayed (oldest removed automatically by store). Empty state: 'No safety decisions yet — waiting for events...' with subtle animation.
implementationPlan.note: Extended event store with safetyDecisions buffer (max 100, newest first). Created SafetyDecisionFeed with FeedRow (timestamp HH:mm:ss.SSS, topic, decision badge, matched rule, eval time), auto-scroll, empty state with pulsing dots.
